nodes.label: Interpretation: gradient-keyed specialization improves out-of-sample net viab...
nodes.statement: Interpretation: gradient-keyed specialization improves out-of-sample net viable growth in a moderate O2 regime, decisively over random fate and modestly (~5% on B) over no fate. The fate rule is designed (engineered); the yield benefit is emergent from the spatial O2 dynamics. It does not hold when O2 is plentiful and is unreliable when O2 is very scarce.

nodes.label: Mechanism: group fitness = largest-cluster toughness (reuses S04 fracture); t...
nodes.statement: Mechanism: group fitness = largest-cluster toughness (reuses S04 fracture); the Price partition splits the group-adhesion change into among-group (Cov(w,z)) and within-group (E[w*dz]) terms. among_group is positive for selection arms and ~0 for drift; within_group is ~0 in EVERY arm because adhesion carries no intrinsic within-group growth advantage under uniform growth. Heritability (parent-offspring regression of group adhesion) is 1.0 clonal / 0.5 mixed, fixed by the clonal/mixed encoding (structural, not emergent).

nodes.label: Clonal group-level selection evolves a heritable adhesion increase (individua...
nodes.statement: Clonal group-level selection evolves a heritable adhesion increase (individuality emerges) that the drift null does not; clonality is required (mixed response attenuated, heritability halved). QUALIFIED — the clean selection-over-drift margin is on training seeds (+0.33); on held-out seeds the drift null drifts up ~+0.10 (boundary reflection of the [0,0.6] init), leaving a modest +0.12 margin. The mixed (non-clonal) control collapses heritability by trait DILUTION, not active within-group conflict (R-S06-DILUTION): with adhesion as the only trait, cheaters have no within-group fitness advantage.
